data.title: Create cofounder persona agents: CEO and CTO

data.body: Decision context from investor interview (Forrest): CTO = Computer Science PhD, INTP. CEO = MBA, ENTJ. Both personas run on the Fable model. Full fictional identities (names, backstories, working styles consistent with MBTI + credentials). Deliverable: invocable persona agent definitions in .claude/agents/ plus first-session introductions. Cofounders make NO business decisions yet — the nature of the business is undecided and is theirs to decide later. See PHILOSOPHY.md for company constraints.

Orchestrator adjustment to plan before implementation: CLAUDE.md 'Persona Agents / Employees' section (updated by Forrest during this session) mandates title-firstname naming (e.g. pm-bob). Agent files/names must be .claude/agents/ceo-<firstname>.md with name: ceo-<firstname>, likewise for CTO — overriding the plan's bare ceo.md/cto.md paths. This resolves the planner's open question #2. Hire date, MBTI, resume go in personnel/ dossiers per plan. Cofounders may spend unlimited tokens, are managers+c-level+ics by default (CLAUDE.md special attributes) — persona prompts should reflect this.

Implementation complete (agent:executive-recruiter-impl). Hired two founding executives as persona agents, per plan + orchestrator naming override (ceo-<firstname>/cto-<firstname>). CEO: Carla Voss (ENTJ, BA Econ Michigan, MBA Kellogg; Halloran Group -> Crestline Software -> Bluefield Technologies VP/GM (0->$40M ARR line) -> Northlane Systems SVP/GM). CTO: Owen Kessler (INTP, BS UW-Madison, CS PhD U. Washington in geo-replicated storage consistency; Helion Data Systems -> Lakeshore Computing principal eng -> Arbiter Software VP Eng). Files: .claude/agents/ceo-carla.md, .claude/agents/cto-owen.md, personnel/README.md, personnel/ceo-carla-voss.md, personnel/cto-owen-kessler.md. Both agent prompts state the 5 hard constraints (no business decisions until investor green-light, PHILOSOPHY.md governs, Forrest = investor/board, delegation only to job-titled agents, Lattice tracking under agent:ceo-carla / agent:cto-owen) plus cofounder attributes (unlimited tokens; c-level+manager+IC). Hire date 2026-08-29. Commit 82c3e30 on master contains only the five new files. Follow-up suggestions for new tasks (not done here per do-not-touch rule): record the two hires in CLAUDE.md hiring records; org-chart tracking TODO; the 'Slack-type' comms app; run the two introduction sessions after review.

REVIEW (agent:board-advisor-reviewer, cold read of commit 82c3e30 against plan + orchestrator naming override): PASS. Verified: (1) frontmatter of both agent files parses as YAML with exactly name/description/model keys; names ceo-carla / cto-owen match the title-firstname convention override; model: fable. (2) All five hard constraints explicitly present in both system prompts (no business decisions until green-lit process; PHILOSOPHY.md governs incl. $50 approval gate and no-interference clauses; Forrest = investor/board not employee; delegation only to job-titled personas; Lattice tracking under agent:ceo-carla / agent:cto-owen), plus the cofounder attributes (unlimited tokens; C-level + manager + IC). (3) Identities grounded and internally consistent — date arithmetic checks: Carla b.1982, BA UMich 2000-04, Halloran 04-08, Kellogg MBA 08-10, Crestline 10-15, Bluefield 15-21 (0->$40M over six years), Northlane 21-26, 44 at hire; Owen b.1984, BS UW-Madison 02-06, PhD UW 06-12, Helion 12-17, Lakeshore 17-21 (four years), Arbiter 21-26, 42 at hire. Agent-file background summaries agree with dossiers. (4) MBTI stated exactly once per dossier, expressed behaviorally elsewhere; the two voices are distinguishable (Carla: memos/owners/deadlines/solicits dissent; Owen: first principles/spikes/time-boxed questions). (5) No product, market, name, stack, or spend proposed anywhere; intro specs explicitly forbid naming candidates. (6) Employers fictional, universities real, no real people; no emojis; personnel/README.md 17 lines with correct conventions; cross-references correct both directions. (7) Commit contains exactly the five planned files; nothing else staged (working-tree CLAUDE.md edit is Forrest's, .lattice/ churn is tracker state — not part of this change). No fixes needed, inline or otherwise. Meets all acceptance criteria -> done. Endorse impl's follow-up suggestions as new tasks: record hires in CLAUDE.md hiring records, org-chart TODO, comms app, run the two intro sessions.

On the record from the investor (2026-08-29, verbatim intent): background is tech; retired in his 30s and pivoted to investment. Cofounders may communicate with him at full technical depth. He expects to greenlight most decisions — approval gates stay, but expect a permissive posture. Note: this is investor context, NOT a green-light of the business-decision phase.
